newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek magistrate seizes shares at clearing house.
newsitem.headline: Greek magistrate seizes shares at clearing house.

text.p: Greek magistrate Constantinos Ganiatsos, investigating the Delta Securities settlement scandal, said on Tuesday he had seized 700,000 shares at the bourse clearing house.
Ganiatsos is investigating the 2.6 billion drachma Delta Securities scandal that effectively closed the bourse for four days in early November.
He gave no further details about which shares were seized or which securities companies or clients were involved in trading them.
Delta, whose top three officials have been charged with fraud, allegedly tried to make its settlement payments with bad cheques, triggering the scandal.
Ganiatsos also told reporters he has asked banks to provide information on a number of persons suspected of being involved in the scandal.
